subject: [PATCH 1/2] mm/vmscan: consolidate promo vs. high watermark checks

reviews.author: Lorenzo (ARM)
reviews.summary: Reviewer requested that the patch series be sent as two or more patches with a cover letter, and provided information on how to format the patches using git format-patch
reviews.raw_body:
Hi Joshua.

Please send patch series of two patches or greater with a cover letter,
with each email sent in-reply-to the cover letter.

The easiest way of accomplishing this (+ our preference) is to use
b4 [0], otherwise format patches like this:

$ git format-patch --cover-letter --thread ...

(You've got 22 patches landed in mm, I shouldn't need to say this :)

[0]: https://b4.docs.kernel.org/en/latest/contributor/send.html

--
Cheers, Lorenzo

reviews.author: Lorenzo (ARM)
reviews.summary: Reviewer Lorenzo (ARM) expressed concerns that the new code introduces additional complexity and duplication, violating conventions for watermark checks. They suggested refactoring the code to pay down technical debt, potentially adding a preceding patch in the series.
reviews.raw_body:
I know this code is hardly the cleanest, but you're now adding a 3rd condition
to a branch that was already complicated enough to have a massive comment and
duplicating a block of code that already dupliclated twice here.

You're also then going against the convention of

	mark = ...
	if (... !zone_watermark_fast(zone, order, mark,
					 ac->highest_zoneidx, alloc_flags,
					 gfp_mask)) {

(Obviously yours varies on alloc_flags too)

And also inlining the mark value.

Could you clean this up a little given this isn't a fix?

In general extending functionality should pay down some technical debt if
possible, it's ok to add a preceding patch in the series to do something like
that.

reviews.author: Joshua Hahn (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged that a cover letter would be beneficial for future versions of the patch series, agreeing to add one if v2 is submitted.
reviews.raw_body:
Hi Lorenzo,

You're right ; -) If this series gets a v2, I'll be sure to add a
cover letter. I just wasn't sure what I would include in it that
wasn't covered in the commit messages themselves, but I think I could
offer some more explanation of how this was discovered and why there's
no CC: stable in the patches.

Thanks! Have a great day Lorenzo,
Joshua

reviews.author: Joshua Hahn (author)
reviews.summary: Author agreed to restructure the patch in v2 to address Lorenzo's feedback by folding the entire check into a helper function, including comment block and related cleanups.
reviews.raw_body:
Hi Lorenzo,

Thanks for taking a look at the patches! I think your requests are
valid here, let me fold that whole check into a helper function
including the comment block and hopefully that will make
get_page_from_freelist() a bit easier to read @_@. I also found an
unused gfp argument anyways, so I'll fold in some related cleanups and
send a new series.

I'll wait until tomorrow to send it out to see if other folks have
concerns with this. Thanks again, have a great day!
Joshua

2026-11-06.patch_summary: This patch consolidates the checks for the watermark that kswapd reclaims zones up to into a single helper function, kswapd_wmark_pages(). The function determines whether to use the promo or high watermark based on the NUMA balancing mode. This change is made to simplify the code and reduce duplication. No functional changes are intended by this patch.
